entries.note: User confirmed successful creation and joining of a local multiplayer game on 2026-09-13 with both Nucleus instances. Earlier independent-controller and left/right layout checks passed. The game files are unpatched; the local GOG API adapter and EOS LAN provide service initialization. Long campaign progression/save loading was not part of this test.

Stable Player1/Player2 folders keep saves separate across controller reconnects. Seed only installer default INIs, never the shared Documents directory. Runtime verified that -home populates each separate player directory and writes its own INIs.

OpenXinput and the XInput-only SDL hints have been tested in NWN2 with both physical controllers. The user confirmed independent input on 2026-09-13. ProtoInput startup injection is required; do not enable a competing legacy input hook.

Nucleus bundled Goldberg lacks SteamInternal_SteamAPI_Init. Keep the verified gbe_fork release-2026_08_23 Steam library together with the Galaxy API adapter and pinned Nemirtingas backend. Native original GOG Steam wrapper is not used in the final verified configuration.

The new runtime path provider calls SHGetFolderPathA, PathAppendA and SHCreateDirectoryExA for Documents/Neverwinter Nights 2 before applying -home. This PC uses a Cyrillic OneDrive Documents folder; Nucleus player environments supply ASCII Documents paths. Nucleus temporarily backs up and redirects Personal in HKCU using its built-in environment mechanism, restoring on normal session end. No shared save/config copying is enabled.

entries.note: Host/join succeeded after correcting IUser and IStats ABI mismatches. Galaxy64.dll is the local adapter; NemirtingasGalaxy64.dll is the pinned Nucleus backend SHA2569a44d8414c5a58fa12737be966cd92644b1fcab05831ec608455a7947ba06449. EOSSDK-Win64-Shipping.dll is Splitux EOS LANv2.1.0. No IsLoggedOn bypass is used. All libraries are private copies in each Nucleus instance; delete a symlink before copying a DLL. Backend networking is LAN only. EOSLAN_LOCALHOST_MODE supports discovery on one PC; distinct EOSLAN_USERNAME values isolate peers. EOS library hardcodes trace logging; direct its output to Windows NUL for normal play to avoid continual log growth. Diagnostic handler in research retains per-player logs.
